title: Haunted Grand Piano
description: A decaying grand piano sits in a dark, derelict room with broken keys, scattered sheet music, and dried flowers resting on its open lid and keyboard. Through a tattered curtained window, a pale moon glows in a starry night sky while surreal, cloud-like dream forms with skeletal hands drift through the air.
prompt: A decaying grand piano in a dark abandoned room, broken keys covered in dust and dried flowers, torn sheet music draped across the lid and keyboard, pale moonlight streaming through a tattered curtained window revealing a starry night sky, surreal white cloud-like forms with skeletal hands floating in the air, dark fantasy atmosphere, highly detailed digital painting
